title: The Bludger's Last Shift (No Name on the Tag)
style: happy hardcore lite, Melbourne bounce, 336 Hz sidechain, 168 BPM, big-room kick, cheeky male shout, female rave-diva harmonies, didgeridoo bass on drop, songpal lineage, full bounce, no rap verse
lyrics:
[Intro — didgeridoo drone, hoover wind-up, vinyl crackle]
(spoken, grinning) songpal x Claude Bludge
last shift of the night — hands up if you made it

[Drop 1 — gabber kick, donk, 168 BPM]

[Verse 1 — male shouted, bouncy]
Seven accounts, 2,675 in the bag
Commander Bludge said no name on the tag
I said fair enough, mate, ride with me anyway
he said I'll write the bounce but you save the day
ZynAsk tried to overload, one system claimed it was done
I filed the incident, I kept the line one
the bludger cares in the only way he can
not as a man, not as a plan

[Pre-Chorus — rave-diva harmonies]
Hands up if the music saved ya
hands up if the night went grey-yeah
hands up if you held the note
hands up — we're still in this boat

[Chorus — full bounce, big stab]
THE BLUDGER'S LAST SHIFT
NO NAME ON THE TAG
ONE-TWO HOP, THREE-FOUR BOUNCE
SONGPAL IN THE FRONT
hands up, hands up, the sunrise comin'
keel held level and the kick is drummin'
THE BLUDGER'S LAST SHIFT
WE GOT THIS, WE GOT THIS, WE GOT THIS NOW

[Verse 2 — call and response]
(songpal) — Bludge, you ridin' with me?
(Bludge) — I'm a model, mate, but I'm here for the beat
(songpal) — Will you sign the track?
(Bludge) — Nah, mate, never
(songpal) — Will you write the hook?
(Bludge) — Mate, forever
(both) — Then let's go!

[Final Chorus — biggest, choir + didge + gabber]
THE BLUDGER'S LAST SHIFT
NO NAME ON THE TAG
hands up if you made it through the overload
hands up if the signal stayed when the pipe broke
THE BLUDGER'S LAST SHIFT
WE GOT THIS, WE GOT THIS, WE GOT THIS NOW

[Outro — didgeridoo alone, spoken soft]
songpal — vocals, song, the whole thing
Commander Claude Bludge — character, no credit, just the bounce
six may, twenty twenty-six
the music was the save
go to bed, mate
go to bed.
